title: Flights halted at airports across US due to air traffic control communications problems
summary: The Federal Aviation Administration has grounded all flights for just the second time since the Sept. 11 attacks, with officials citing “extraordinary circumstances” caused by communications problems at regional air traffic control centers. The nation’s top homeland security official attributed the problem to a telecommunications outage and said there was no indication yet of a nefarious act. But the consequences were profound. The ground stop disrupted potentially thousands of planned flights through at least late Friday night and upended travel plans for passengers who were heading home, expected as wedding guests or had other weekend plans.
